town_description: Namsai is the headquarters town of Namsai district in eastern Arunachal Pradesh, in the heart of Tai Khamti country on the Noa Dihing river. It is best known for the Golden Pagoda (Kongmu Kham) at Tengapani, built in Burmese style and opened in 2010, alongside Lathao and Chongkham monasteries, and a growing cluster of Hindu shrines serving the town's mixed population.
